title: DuckStation 0.1-11108: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11108 on April 26, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11108 on April 26, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: 3f52ebe01 gitignore: Add CLion generated directory. 99acb8fb1 ThirdParty/SmallVector: Add missing include. 9275e1ad7 Achievements: Add RA SVG icon variant. a4c53a905 FullscreenUI: Add menu dropdown widgets.
